before.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the provided CSV
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/weather.csv')

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
for city, group in df.groupby('city'):
    ax.scatter(group['temp_c'], group['aqi'], label=city)

ax.set_xlabel('Temperature (°C)')
ax.set_ylabel('AQI')
ax.set_title('Temperature vs AQI')
ax.legend(title='City')
ax.set_xlim(left=0)
ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
